tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List every SEO site in the authenticated user's organisation (id, name, domain, status, last audit timestamp). Use before any other tool to discover which site_ids are valid.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Get one site's metadata (name, domain, status, verification state, last-audit / last-scan timestamps).

tools.name: get_site_audit
tools.description: Latest SEO audit run for a site: overall + per-category scores and issue counts by severity.

tools.name: get_audit_issues
tools.description: Top issues from the latest audit run for a site. Optional filter by severity (critical|high|medium|low). Returns up to `limit` (default 25, max 200) instances.

tools.name: get_score_history
tools.description: Daily audit score history for a site (used for trend lines). Returns the most recent 90 samples.

tools.name: get_keyword_rankings
tools.description: Tracked keyword positions + movement for a site (current + previous position, URL, country, device).

tools.name: get_serp_features
tools.description: Aggregate SERP-feature presence (AI Overview, Featured Snippet, People-Also-Ask, Local Pack, Video, Images, Shopping, Knowledge) across the site's tracked keywords, from the latest ranking run.

tools.name: get_rank_alerts
tools.description: Configured rank-drop alert rules for a site (thresholds + is_active flags).

tools.name: get_ai_overview_presence
tools.description: Google AI Overview coverage for a site: coverage %, delta vs previous run, per-intent buckets, per-keyword state (gained / lost / still-covered / not-covered).

tools.name: get_ai_visibility
tools.description: AI visibility overview for a site: measured mention rate across configured AI engines (OpenRouter / OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Perplexity), current engine set, planned engines.

tools.name: get_prompt_research
tools.description: Per-prompt AI research for a site (target share, leader, rivals, opportunity bucket).

tools.name: get_gsc_metrics
tools.description: Google Search Console metrics for a site. `surface` = organic|ai_overview|ai_mode|discover_ai (default organic); `dimension` = query|page|country|device|date (default query).

tools.name: get_bing_metrics
tools.description: Bing Webmaster Tools metrics for a site (organic; Bing has no Copilot API split). `dimension` = query|page|country|device|date (default query).

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.description: Tracked competitors for a site with their latest snapshot (domain authority, visibility, organic keywords, estimated traffic, backlinks).

tools.name: get_keyword_gaps
tools.description: Top keyword-gap opportunities (keywords a competitor ranks for and the site does not, ordered by opportunity score).

tools.name: get_backlinks_domains
tools.description: Top referring domains for a site with the Pylon-computed 0-100 authority score.

tools.name: get_content_grade
tools.description: Cached content-grade summary for a URL on a site (from the on-page grader).

tools.name: get_cwv
tools.description: Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP, FCP, TTFB) for a site from PageSpeed Insights — mobile + desktop snapshots.

tools.name: get_site_changes
tools.description: Recent SEO changes detected between the two most recent crawls (title / meta / h1 / canonical / indexability / status code).

tools.name: get_scan_pages
tools.description: Newest pages from a site's latest crawl (status code, response time, size, depth, indexable). Windowed at 200 rows.

tools.name: get_market_analysis
tools.description: Market analysis overview for a site: tracked keyword demand aggregates, competitive concentration and provenance chips.

tools.name: get_local_seo
tools.description: Local SEO overview for a site (rank-tracker with local intent). Returns tracked local keywords + rival domains + AI-only rivals.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List stored report runs for the caller's organisation. Optional filter by `site_id` and `kind` (overview|seo_audit|rankings|competitors|ai_visibility).

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Pylon SEO plans and the caller's entitlement: the paid catalogue (Growth / Agency, monthly / yearly) with USD + INR prices, site limits, credits and features, plus the caller's current plan, site usage and trial state, and the website pricing_url where plans are purchased.

tools.name: add_keyword
tools.description: Track a new keyword for a site. `keyword` and `country_code` (ISO-3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. 'us') are required; `intent` (informational|commercial|transactional|navigational) is optional and estimated when omitted.

tools.name: add_competitor
tools.description: Track a new competitor for a site by its bare domain (no protocol). Discovery scan is enqueued asynchronously.

tools.name: add_rank_alert
tools.description: Configure a rank-drop alert rule for a site. `drop_threshold` (positive int) fires when any tracked keyword drops that many positions between runs.

tools.name: start_scan
tools.description: Enqueue a fresh crawl + audit run for a site. Idempotent: a running / queued run short-circuits.

tools.name: start_ranking_run
tools.description: Enqueue a keyword-rankings sweep for a site (resolves every tracked keyword's SERP position).

tools.name: submit_indexnow
tools.description: Push a URL batch to IndexNow (Bing/Yandex/Naver/Seznam) for a site. Requires an existing verified IndexNow key. All URLs must share the site's host.

tools.name: run_public_scan
tools.description: Run the anonymous single-URL SEO checker (public). Returns the same audit shape logged-in users see. Rate-limited per anonymous identity.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_site_audit, get_audit_issues, get_keyword_rankings, get_content_grade · Public sink: get_prompt_research, submit_indexnow · Destructive: get_site_audit, get_audit_issues, get_serp_features, get_rank_alerts, get_ai_overview_presence, add_rank_alert, start_scan, start_ranking_run, run_public_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_site_audit, get_audit_issues, get_keyword_rankings, get_content_grade · Public sink: get_prompt_research, submit_indexnow · Destructive: get_site_audit, get_audit_issues, get_serp_features, get_rank_alerts, get_ai_overview_presence, add_rank_alert, start_scan, start_ranking_run, run_public_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
